auth.welcomeText: Your reliable catalog of coins and collections. Store, track and value your treasures in one place.

add.title: Add
add.subtitlePurchase: The coin and its purchase expense are created together.
add.subtitleExpense: The expense goes to the money journal.
add.coinTitleHint: Start typing — we look through the catalog and your own items. Not in the list? Describe the coin below.
add.noMatches: Nothing found — fill in “About the coin” below.
add.aboutCoinLead: We do not have this coin yet — we will record it together with the purchase, and it will appear in your collection.
add.yearInvalid: Enter the year as a number between 1 and 2200.
add.noDenominations: The dictionary holds no denominations for this country — type it as it is.
add.materialPlaceholder: Pick one or type your own
add.materialHint: Not in the list? Type it as it is.
add.linkedCoinLead: Optional: which coin this expense is about.
add.linkedCoinHint: Picks an existing coin only — nothing new is created here.
add.extraExpensesLead: Delivery, a holder, grading — whatever was spent on this coin along with it. The date and the seller come from the purchase.
add.asidePurchase: Found the coin in the catalog? The purchase is recorded against it. Not there? We create an item in your personal catalog and attach the purchase to it at once.
add.asideExpense: Supporting expenses do not change the collection: they go to the money journal and count towards the totals of the hobby.
add.denominationPlaceholder: Pick one or type your own
add.seriesPlaceholder: Pick one or type your own
add.seriesHint: A name of your own is kept as text: it shows on the card but does not count towards series completeness.
add.catalogNumberHint: KM#, Numista or any other — as your source writes it.
add.descriptionHint: About the coin itself, not the purchase.

slides.title: The whole picture
slides.text: Specimen count, total spending and current valuation — see the key figures together on one screen.

slides.title: Spending and current value
slides.text: Compare what you spent with the current coin valuations. The difference shows how your collection’s value has changed.

slides.title: The series you collect
slides.text: See progress and missing coin counts for the series you have started. Open a series to explore its details.

slides.title: Cards or a table
slides.text: Browse coins with photos or compare them in a table. Multiple specimens of the same issue stay grouped together.

slides.title: Find the right coin
slides.text: Search by name, apply filters and choose a sort order. Collection totals update for the coins you select.

slides.title: Every specimen has a story
slides.text: Keep the purchase price and date, grade, storage location and notes for each individual specimen.

completeness.heading: From first coin to full set

slides.title: Choose what you collect
slides.text: Group coins by series, year, denomination, material, edge or quality. Narrow the selection by country and metal.

slides.title: Progress in every group
slides.text: See how many distinct coins you own and how many are missing. Duplicate specimens do not increase completeness.

slides.title: Plan your next addition
slides.text: Open a group to browse missing coins and see an estimated cost to complete it, based on available valuations.

slides.title: Coins and related expenses
slides.text: Purchases appear in the journal automatically. Add shipping, albums and other costs with a coin or separately.

slides.title: Spending over time
slides.text: Choose one, three or six months, a year, or custom dates. The period changes the chart; overall totals stay the same.

slides.title: A clear spending journal
slides.text: Filter entries by category to see dates, descriptions and amounts. The journal category does not change the chart.
